f1_note: Precision and Recall are unweighted means across 14 classes at the confidence maximizing smoothed mean class F1 (IoU 0.5). f1 is harmonic mean of those aggregate P/R; macro_f1 is mean per-class F1. Neither is micro-F1. Others has zero recall at this point; precision 1 is an empty-prediction interpolation convention, not perfect detection.
fps_note: Ultralytics validation stage profiler does not synchronize MPS. Its stage times and derived throughput are diagnostic only; do not use as latency or video FPS. Use the explicit synchronized batch-one latency report.
